## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences describing the change. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — adds or fixes tests
- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling or build pipeline

## Testing

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] Manual smoke test in Chrome (load unpacked, add reminder, wait for alert).

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] No automated-assistant attribution in commits, code, or docs.
- [ ] Public functions carry JSDoc.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `## [Unreleased]` if behaviour changed.
